references.phrase: filtration indexed by real times t>=0
references.context: Increasing family of sigma algebras F_t indexed by the nonnegative real numbers.
Finite expectation of absolute value at every time t.

references.phrase: almost sure equality of random variables
references.context: Conditional expectation equals X_s outside a probability-zero exceptional set.
For all nonnegative real time pairs with s<=t, conditional expectation of later value given F_s equals earlier value.

references.disposition: Continuous-index timing does not imply sample paths have any continuity properties.

review_rationale: Reviewed continuous-index real-valued martingale in filtration t>=0 with adaptation, integrable X_t at every time and conditional expectation identity for all s<=t, absent path-continuity assumption.
